system.notes:
Pink, pony-sized crab-mollusk with eight beady eyes. From its kelp-covered top sprouts three humanoid heads on long necks that sing a baffling cacophony.

AC 15, HP 39, ATK 2 bite +6 (3d6) or 3 sonic ray (far) +6 (2d6), MV near (swim), S +4, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 8

Cacophony. Siren's three heads howl a disruptive aria. Spellcasting within double near of siren has DISADV.

False Heads. Heads can be severed. AC 11, 3 HP. If all three heads are severed, cacophony stops. For each head severed, -1 sonic ray.

Half-Amphibious. Must be submerged in water every 4 hours or suffocates.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
